evidence: Has the macOS label and resolves a platform-specific runtime failure where select() rejects timeouts exceeding 10^8 seconds on macOS and BSD.
rationale: Fixes a platform-specific runtime failure on macOS where bitcoin-cli with -rpcclienttimeout=0 fails immediately with 'Could not connect to the server'. While it resolves a supported-platform regression introduced in #34342, it affects only a specific CLI flag rather than overall ability to build or run on the platform.
